world.h: Russia, Ukraine and US negotiators meet in Abu Dhabi
world.b: The talks are the first three-way round since February, with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner mediating. European foreign ministers pressed Secretary of State Marco Rubio for a seat at the table.
world.title: Russia, Ukraine and US officials hold talks in Abu Dhabi

world.h: Trump calls Iran war 'effectively over' militarily after Qatar talks
world.b: After meeting Qatar's prime minister and Vice President JD Vance, Trump said the US is keeping the status quo at the request of Iran's neighbors. The Qatari leader cited positive talks on reaching a deal.
world.title: After meeting Qatar PM, Trump calls Iran war ‘effectively over’ militarily

world.h: GCC states approve military headquarters located in Kuwait
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the US-Israel war on Iran.
world.title: GCC states approve military headquarters located in Kuwait

national.h: Door-to-door shots slow measles in Amish country
national.b: In Chester County, Pennsylvania, health department supervisor Dale Weiser has spent months driving to Amish homes to vaccinate families against measles. Word of mouth has spread her phone number through the community almost as fast as the virus.
national.title: How word of mouth is helping an Amish community's fight against measles

national.h: Supreme Court lets border wall in Big Bend National Park proceed
national.b: The court lifted a lower-court injunction that had paused construction while the case is litigated. Conservationists, local officials and some Republicans oppose the wall.

national.h: Two security breaches near White House prompt brief lockdown
national.b: A vehicle crash and a person jumping a barrier at Lafayette Park happened around the same time Monday morning while Trump was in the residence. The lockdown lifted an hour later.

national.h: Nebraska cancer patient lost Medicaid under rushed work rules
national.b: Eli McCreary of Omaha said a hospital told him he was no longer insured, and a call center said he had not met the new work requirement.

national.h: Supreme Court weighs whether federal officers can be sued for rights violations
national.b: The case of Kekai Watanabe, a federal prisoner denied care for a fractured tailbone, could shape accountability for federal agents, including immigration officers.

politics.h: House Republicans pick a new leader after midterm losses
politics.b: A week after losing the majority, House Republicans meet behind closed doors Tuesday to choose a minority leader to succeed Mike Johnson. The race is between Majority Leader Steve Scalise and Ohio's Jim Jordan, a co-founder of the House Freedom Caucus.
politics.title: House Republicans to elect a new leader as they look to rebuild from midterm defeat

politics.h: Poll: Voters 3 to 1 less likely to back pro-war candidates
politics.b: 44% said a candidate's support for the Iran war made them less likely to vote for them, versus 13% more likely. A majority, 53%, said Congress should decide when the war ends.
politics.title: Poll finds Americans less likely to back pro-war candidates by 3-1 margin

politics.h: Massie files articles of impeachment against Hegseth
politics.b: The outgoing Kentucky Republican reintroduced eight articles as the House returned Monday, accusing the defense secretary of carrying out unlawful orders.

politics.h: Biden memoir says Trump should carry Jan. 6 'to his grave'
politics.b: The first excerpt of "Promise Me, America," published by The Atlantic, accuses Trump of trying to "tear down institutions." The full book comes out Nov. 17.

politics.h: Trump reverses stance and alleges fraud in midterm elections
politics.b: Trump questioned the results on Truth Social without evidence. A Pew analysis found pre-election polls understated Democratic margins by at least 2 points in 23 of 27 governor and Senate races.

politics.h: Firm tied to Trump's sons won nearly $40 million to screen for Ebola, ProPublica reports
politics.b: XpresTest has screened travelers at US airports but has never worked with Ebola or provided biosecurity services abroad.
politics.title: Firm Tied to Trump Sons Won Nearly $40 Million in Federal Funds to Screen for Ebola, Other Diseases

politics.h: Trump says his immigration policy may be 'too tough' for voters
politics.b: In a 60 Minutes interview after Republicans lost both chambers, Trump said an immigration deal with the new Democratic Congress is "actually doable."

international.h: Europe presses Rubio for a seat at Ukraine talks
international.b: Meeting in Paris with G7 counterparts, European foreign ministers told Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Europe must have a say in any deal to end Russia's war on Ukraine, as US-mediated talks began in Abu Dhabi. Germany's Johann Wadephul rejected any fundamental change to Europe's security architecture.
international.title: European diplomats press Rubio for a role in Russia-Ukraine talks

international.h: Israeli forces kill 14-year-old Palestinian in West Bank raid
international.b: Moataz Iyad Daghlas was shot in the village of Burqa near Nablus, and two other teens were wounded. Israel's military said soldiers fired to stop stone-throwing.
international.title: Israeli forces kill 14-year-old Palestinian boy in occupied West Bank

international.h: Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired at Riyadh
international.b: A Saudi-led coalition spokesperson blamed the Houthis after two ballistic missiles and a cruise missile were intercepted, following an attack on a key pipeline.
international.title: Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired at Riyadh after Houthi attack on pipeline

international.h: Cameroon sets Feb. 7 date for twice-delayed elections
international.b: President Paul Biya, 93, announced the legislative and local vote by decree as authorities crack down on the opposition a year after his disputed reelection.
international.title: Cameroon sets date for twice-delayed legislative and local elections

international.h: Pope Leo meets clergy abuse survivors in Argentina
international.b: The closed-door meetings followed an open-air Mass in Buenos Aires that drew an estimated 2.5 million people, the country's first papal liturgy in nearly 40 years.

international.h: Russia's Novaya Gazeta closes its Moscow office
international.b: The country's last major independent outlet critical of the Kremlin said authorities and security services forced its editorial team to stop operating.
international.title: Citing government pressure, Russia's top independent newspaper closes its office after three decades

international.h: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 and a half years for rape and sexual assault
international.b: A London court sentenced the 51-year-old comedian after he was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault.

international.h: Thick smog blankets New Delhi after Diwali fireworks
international.b: Despite restrictions, firecrackers on Sunday night pushed the air quality index above 350 in several parts of the capital, the severe category.

international.h: Bangladesh's ousted leader Sheikh Hasina seeks passport to return
international.b: Hasina, sentenced to death in absentia over the 2024 protest crackdown, told Reuters she plans to return from India in December and surrender to a court.

international.h: Mudslide kills five in Gaza displacement camp
international.b: Four children and a woman died when a sandbank collapsed onto their tent in Deir el-Balah after the first winter storm, and two people remain missing. Residents dug with their bare hands for survivors.

international.h: Drone attack halts production at Iraq's Khor Mor gasfield
international.b: The strike cut gas to power plants across the Kurdish region, knocking 2,500 to 2,800 megawatts off the grid. It was not clear who carried it out.

business.h: Gates holds $29 billion stake in landfill giant
business.b: A ProPublica investigation finds Bill Gates owns 38% of Republic Services, America's No. 2 landfill operator. EPA inspectors have repeatedly found methane escaping Republic landfills above federal limits, and the company has lobbied against rules that would make the waste industry cleaner.
business.title: Bill Gates Wants to Stop Global Warming. He’s Earned Billions From Climate-Polluting Landfills.

business.h: Meta expands automated teen age checks worldwide
business.b: The technology moves users it believes are teens into Teen Account protections even if they list an adult birthday.

business.h: China calls Nvidia spy claims a smear campaign
business.b: Beijing denied trying to ensnare CEO Jensen Huang, who apologized to his wife and company for an affair and said he supports Nvidia's investigation.

business.h: Palantir hires former Sen. Jon Tester ahead of Democratic Congress
business.b: Tech companies expecting scrutiny from the incoming majorities are hiring former Democratic lawmakers. Tester said his role is advisory, not lobbying.

business.h: Asian stocks climb after tech rout
business.b: Taiwan's Taiex jumped 5.72% and Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 3.45% on Monday, following a Friday rebound on Wall Street. US stock futures also edged higher.

science.h: Seattle scientist hunts herpes where it hides in the body
science.b: Fred Hutch virologist Keith Jerome is using gene editing to find and clear viruses that stay in the body for life, work that could one day lead to a herpes cure.

science.h: UN climate talks open in Turkey under the shadow of the Iran war
science.b: COP31 begins in Antalya as the war's energy crisis drives up oil and gas prices. Analysts say cheap solar, batteries and electric vehicles give countries a new way out of fossil fuel shocks.

sports.h: Kevin McGonigle and Sal Stewart win Rookie of the Year
sports.b: The Tigers' McGonigle took 28 of 30 first-place votes in the AL, and the Reds' Stewart won in the NL.

sports.h: Jaguars trade for Eagles defensive tackle Jordan Davis
sports.b: Jacksonville sent a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick to Philadelphia on the eve of the trade deadline, after also adding Jessie Bates III and Davon Godchaux.
sports.title: Jordan Davis trade grades: Eagles kickstart rebuild, Jaguars push for 2026 AFC and Super Bowl titles

sports.h: College Football Playoff expanding to 24 teams in 2027
sports.b: The new format has 19 at-large bids, four for Power Four champions and one for the top Group of Six champion, and will eliminate conference championship games, CBS Sports reports.

sports.h: Jaguars acquire All-Pro safety Jessie Bates III from Falcons
sports.b: Atlanta gets a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick. Jacksonville is 6-2, and the NFL trade deadline is Tuesday.

sports.h: Jonathan Taylor says goodbye to Indianapolis as trade deadline nears
sports.b: The Colts running back thanked the city after a 27-23 loss to Dallas, saying he plays every game like it's his last. The NFL trade deadline is Tuesday.

sports.h: Ja'Marr Chase leads Bengals past Falcons 34-17 in Madrid
sports.b: Chase caught 10 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown, most of it in the first half, as Cincinnati won on international soil for the first time.

sports.h: NC State finalizing deal to hire Philip Rivers as coach
sports.b: The former Wolfpack quarterback has coached high school football in Alabama since 2021, and this would be his first college job. He would replace Dave Doeren, who was fired after a Week 8 loss to Stanford.

goodnews.h: Norway's eider keepers build nests for migrating ducks
goodnews.b: On the Vega Islands, just south of the Arctic Circle, keepers shelter nesting eider ducks each spring and collect their prized down.
goodnews.title: Eider keepers of the subarctic Norway care for migrating ducks, collect their luxury feathers

goodnews.h: Apocalyptic satire 'The End of Everything' wins the Booker Prize
goodnews.b: Judges' chair Mary Beard said M. John Harrison's novel leaves readers with "a twinge of optimism."

local.h: East Harlem buildings head to auction despite City Hall push
local.b: Thirty-eight deteriorating buildings with about 850 mostly rent-stabilized apartments, formerly owned by bankrupt Emerald Equities Group, go to auction starting Tuesday. Mayor Mamdani's administration had backed a bid by affordable housing developer Spatial Equity to buy the portfolio first.
local.title: Rent-stabilized buildings hit auction block, despite Mamdani’s efforts to intervene

local.h: T-Mobile throttled affordable internet for low-income New Yorkers, AG says
local.b: T-Mobile agreed to improve service after the attorney general's office found it capped speeds and made the discounted plans hard to find. Only 15 households had enrolled.
local.title: T-Mobile slowed Internet to a crawl for NY low-income users, AG says

local.h: NJ Gov. Sherrill picks Shirley Emehelu as lieutenant governor
local.b: The former prosecutor and acting secretary of state replaces Dale Caldwell, who resigned in September. Women now hold New Jersey's two highest executive offices for the first time.
local.title: NJ Gov. Sherrill announces her new lieutenant governor pick

local.h: One dead in Hamilton Heights apartment fire
local.b: The fire started in a cluttered third-floor unit of a Riverside Drive building around 1:30 a.m. Five others, including two firefighters, were hurt. FDNY says 87 people have died in fires this year, up from 45 at this point last year.
local.title: 1 dead after early morning fire rips through Hamilton Heights apartment building, FDNY says

local.h: NYC expands Code Blue cold-weather help for homeless New Yorkers
local.b: The city is adding $25 million, 300 more outreach workers and 800 more beds for nights below freezing. More than two dozen people died in the cold last winter.
local.title: Mamdani says more help is coming to homeless New Yorkers living outside this winter

periods.name: Today
periods.text: Cloudy through mid morning, then gradual clearing, with a high near 61. West wind 9 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 25 mph.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Clear, with a low around 51. West wind 9 to 13 mph.

periods.name: Veterans Day
periods.text: Increasing clouds, with a high near 61. West wind 6 to 8 mph.

periods.name: Wednesday Night
periods.text: Mostly cloudy, with a low around 53. Light and variable wind becoming east 5 to 7 mph after midnight.

periods.name: Thursday
periods.text: Rain, mainly after 1pm.  High near 59. East wind 10 to 13 mph.  Chance of precipitation is 80%. New precipitation amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

periods.name: Thursday Night
periods.text: Rain.  Low around 45. Breezy.  Chance of precipitation is 80%. New precipitation amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.
